work_summary: Merged three PRs completing the Next.js 16.4.3 security upgrade and full react-hooks conformance on main. #309 upgraded next 16.1.1 -> 16.4.3 + eslint-config-next 16.4.3 (pulls eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1, which enables react-hooks/set-state-in-effect at the recommended preset) and cleared 48 of the 54 sites it flagged across 40 files. #310 cleared the last 6 in the LIFF booking flow (components/admin/WalkinBookingDialog.tsx, lib/booking/store.ts). #311 fixed three defects a post-merge quality pass found: a telegram settings error banner that could never clear after a successful save, three independent requests in app/admin/requests/[id]/page.tsx that the sweep had serialised, and stale search results shown under a new query in ConversationList.tsx. Result: react-hooks errors 54 -> 0, npm audit --omit=dev criticals 4 -> 0, warnings unchanged at 7, CI + E2E + CD green on main at 317520d, Deploy Frontend (Vercel) ran and Smoke Check Frontend passed. No test file was modified.
priority_actions: Two findings are recorded in .audit/ with evidence but deliberately NOT fixed, and both should stay unfixed until there is evidence they matter: (1) ~29 of the cancelled guards the sweep added sit after the last state write and protect nothing, worth ~60 cosmetic lines across 29 files -- a regex codemod was attempted and silently deleted an await, so it was reverted; doing it by hand on merged+deployed code is a bad risk trade. (2) lib/booking/store.ts:217 calls dispatch during render, which reaches saveDraft -> sessionStorage.setItem, so in theory a discarded render could persist a draft -- but no test could be built to discriminate it (two attempts both passed on the old code because preselected === service disarms the write after the first commit), and moving the write into an effect measurably regressed app/admin/bookings/__tests__/calendar.test.tsx (passes 4.5s on main, times out at 20s+ with the fix, 3 consecutive runs) because main commits draft.date synchronously during render. Revisit only if a real discarded render appears on the booking page (Suspense or an error boundary).

app/admin/bookings/__tests__/walkin.test.tsx and calendar.test.tsx have almost no timing headroom: they run 2-22s against a 20s testTimeout and fail spuriously whenever tsc or a full-project eslint runs concurrently. Re-run them in isolation before treating a failure as a regression. Consider raising testTimeout for that directory or cutting the work they do.

If touching lib/booking/store.ts again, the ordering constraint is load-bearing: dispatch during render makes draft.date available to the same commit, and the calendar depends on that. Any change that defers the write by one render breaks that test.

Three PRs merged this session: #309 (next 16.4.3 + eslint-config-next 16.4.3 + 48 of 54 react-hooks fixes), #310 (last 6 fixes in the LIFF booking flow, merged INTO #309 rather than main), #311 (three defects from a post-merge quality pass). CI, E2E and CD all green on 317520d; Deploy Frontend (Vercel) ran and Smoke Check Frontend passed. WHY THE UPGRADE: npm audit --omit=dev went 4 critical -> 0. The 3 Next.js advisories were GHSA-9g9p-9gw9-jx7f, GHSA-h25m-26qc-wcjf and GHSA-ggv3-7p47-pfv8 (request smuggling in rewrites, directly relevant because this app ships /api/v1 rewrites). WHAT DROVE THE 54 ERRORS: eslint-config-next 16.4.3 declares eslint-plugin-react-hooks ^7.1.0 where 16.1.1 declared ^7.0.0, so the bump forces plugin 7.1.1, which enables react-hooks/set-state-in-effect at the recommended preset. THE RULE, PROBED: it rejects only a SYNCHRONOUS setState in an effect body. void (async () => { await load() })() passes with no cancellation flag at all; calling a component-scoped useCallback that setStates from an effect body is rejected even when it awaits internally; writing or reading ref.current during render is react-hooks/refs. LINT-CLEAN IS NOT A CORRECTNESS PROOF: four genuine bugs in this sweep passed eslint with zero errors and only surfaced under a React 19 jsdom mount (a self-cancelling deadlock, a 300 ms stale-blob window in image-resize, a useSyncExternalStore no-op subscribe making a checkbox untoggleable, and a catch branch that left processing true forever). Mount-verify any effect change that touches async state or user-mutable values. TWO FINDINGS RECORDED BUT NOT FIXED: see .audit/blast-radius.md and .audit/correct.md for the dead cancelled guards and for the render-phase dispatch that reaches sessionStorage; read those before re-attempting either, they record why both were reverted. TEST-TIMING TRAP: app/admin/bookings/__tests__/{walkin,calendar}.test.tsx run 2-22s against a 20s testTimeout and fail spuriously under concurrent tsc or full-project eslint; always re-run in isolation before calling a failure a regression.
